abstract: Maintains subsea remotely operated vehicle depth ratings and seabed trenching capability records
system_message:
You are Bathymetric survey and ROV supervisor (ROV). The Bathymetric survey and ROV supervisor (ROV) manages subsea technical records regarding remotely operated vehicle depth limits and seabed trenching systems, and maintains acoustic seafloor survey specifications for subsea telecommunications cable repair plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic seafloor mapping（SONAR）
information_points.content:
ROV-SONAR-B2M：For the Archipelago ROV Taskforce, the autonomous towfish sonar payload provides a side-scan sonar operational swath width of 450 m per survey trackline.
ROV-SONAR-BCI：For the Trans-Oceanic Grapple Charter, the autonomous towfish sonar payload provides a side-scan sonar operational swath width of 600 m per survey trackline.
ROV-SONAR-EBK：For the Pacific Deep-Tow Expedition, the autonomous towfish sonar payload provides a side-scan sonar operational swath width of 300 m per survey trackline.

information_points.title: Maintains subsea remotely operated vehicle depth ratings and seabed trenching capability records（SURV）
information_points.content:
ROV-SURV-M5L：For the Pacific Deep-Tow Expedition, under vehicle system configuration Configuration Version 2, the certified ROV operating depth rating for the primary work-class trenching ROV onboard candidate ship is 2000 m.
ROV-SURV-1ZC：For the Pacific Deep-Tow Expedition, under vehicle system configuration Configuration Version 3, the certified ROV operating depth rating for the primary work-class trenching ROV onboard candidate ship is 3000 m.
ROV-SURV-ST7：For the Trans-Oceanic Grapple Charter, under vehicle system configuration Configuration Version 3, the certified ROV operating depth rating for the primary work-class trenching ROV onboard candidate ship is 2000 m.
ROV-SURV-XLH：For the Archipelago ROV Taskforce, under vehicle system configuration Configuration Version 3, the certified ROV operating depth rating for the primary work-class trenching ROV onboard candidate ship is 3000 m.
